clue.text: Shown by one following teacher. Mark showed it

definitions.meaning: the condition of a pupil or adherent devoted to a master
St Mark, the evangelist, was a follower of Jesus and displayed this devotion

explanation.walkthrough: 'Mark' looks like an ordinary boy's name or a grade, but here it is St Mark, the gospel writer, a follower of Jesus.
explanation.definitionFit: The state of being a follower of a religious teacher is exactly what a gospel writer such as Mark exhibited.

clue.text: Intending testator may express bitter feeling

definitions.meaning: someone planning to make a will might say they will draw one up, split as two words

explanation.walkthrough: Read as 'I'll will', the phrase is what a person about to make their will might announce.
explanation.definitionFit: A would-be testator promises to make a will, and the same letters name malevolence or animosity.

clue.text: Credit note to play the old instrument

indicators.note: the letters are made to play about, so they are rearranged

parts.note: CR is the standard abbreviation for credit in accounts

explanation.surface: A musician given credit for playing a note on an antique instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to play' looks musical but signals the anagram of CR plus NOTE TO.
explanation.definitionFit: The cornetto was a Renaissance wind instrument with finger holes and a cup mouthpiece, long obsolete.

clue.text: Page that gives support to the dog show

indicators.note: in a down answer a letter that supports another sits beneath it, so it comes after

parts.note: a pom is a Pomeranian, a small dog

explanation.surface: A page boy holds up a dog at a canine show.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry, 'that gives support to' puts P underneath POM.
explanation.definitionFit: Pomp is ceremonial display or splendid pageantry.

clue.text: Alec's not A, perhaps, but is showing rapid development

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the letters may be in some other order, an anagram signal

parts.note: the name Alec, its possessive ending giving no letter

explanation.surface: Someone insists Alec is no A-grade student, though he is coming on quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' looks like a hedge but rearranges ALEC, NOT, A and IS; 'but' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An escalation is a rapid increase or intensification of something.

clue.text: Country music missing Bill is certainly not flat

indicators.note: missing tells us a part has been dropped from the longer word

parts.note: hillbilly is an old name for rural American country music
the name is taken as written

explanation.surface: A remark that country music without Bill on the bill is far from dull.
explanation.walkthrough: Take BILL out of HILLBILLY; 'flat' looks musical, but means level ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Terrain full of rises and slopes is the opposite of level.

clue.text: Serviceman with the medics, say. That's an oddity

parts.note: a para is a paratrooper

indicators.note: say signals that the word is spoken and only its sound is kept

parts.note: docs are doctors, informally

explanation.surface: A soldier working with doctors seems a strange combination.
explanation.walkthrough: DOCS spoken is DOX; 'That's an' links to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A paradox is a self-contradictory or puzzling thing, an anomaly.

clue.text: One may need to, when sunbathing, to avoid criticism?

definitions.text: One may need to, when sunbathing
definitions.meaning: literally, put sun cream or a shirt over the shoulders and spine
the idiom for protecting yourself from blame

explanation.walkthrough: The literal and idiomatic senses of the phrase are both used.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally shielding your shoulders from the sun; idiomatically, taking precautions so nobody can fault you.

clue.text: One giving treatment with a few points to make

definitions.text: One giving treatment with a few points to make

parts.words: One giving treatment with a few points to make
parts.note: a therapist who works with needles, the points, rather than one arguing a case

explanation.surface: A doctor who has some arguments to put across.
explanation.walkthrough: 'points to make' suggests arguments, but the points are needles.
explanation.definitionFit: This practitioner treats patients by inserting fine needles at chosen spots on the body.

clue.text: Fuel VAT?

parts.note: not a tax on fuel, but a large vat or barrel holding fuel

explanation.walkthrough: VAT reads as the value added tax, but it is a container.
explanation.definitionFit: A big cylindrical metal barrel for storing petroleum is a tank for fuel.

clue.text: Rail co, about to make changes (concerned with heat)

indicators.note: the letters are changed around, so they are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
co is short for company
C, for circa, means about

explanation.surface: A railway company about to make changes, in a note about heating.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearrange RAIL, CO and C (circa); 'Rail co.' is a railway company.
explanation.definitionFit: Caloric means relating to heat or calories.

clue.text: Pick a piece from the literature

indicators.note: piece from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Choose an extract from some literature.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer runs across thE LITErature.
explanation.definitionFit: The pick of something is its best part, the cream.

clue.text: Functioned badly, so redoubled one's efforts

definitions.meaning: a machine that misbehaves is said to do this
to play harder, to go at it more vigorously

explanation.walkthrough: 'so' is a link between the two senses.
explanation.definitionFit: A faulty engine misbehaved; separately, a team that tried harder gave more.

clue.text: I'd run a cafe in a special way to serve this!

definitions.text: I'd run a cafe in a special way to serve this!

indicators.note: the letters are arranged in a different manner, an anagram signal

explanation.surface: A cafe owner promises a signature dish prepared their own way.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearrange the letters of I'D RUN A CAFE; the whole clue also defines.
explanation.definitionFit: Fricandeau is a French dish of braised veal, the kind a cafe might serve.

clue.text: Strike out with a better oil mix

indicators.note: mix means the letters are blended into a new order

explanation.surface: Advice on removing a stain with an improved lubricant.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearrange A BETTER OIL.
explanation.definitionFit: To obliterate is to wipe out or erase completely.

clue.text: Neat cross seen in one after refurbishment

indicators.note: seen in places one piece inside the other
refurbishment remakes the word, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: X is the shape of a cross

explanation.surface: A tidy cross appearing in a renovated building.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Neat' is an old word for cattle; X goes into OEN, the rearranged ONE.
explanation.definitionFit: Neat is an archaic term for bovine animals, cattle.

clue.text: Swedish physicist's storage device appearing after some anxiety

indicators.note: the storage device comes after the anxiety in the answer

parts.note: angst is anxiety or dread
ROM is read-only memory in computing

explanation.surface: A Swedish scientist's computer memory turns up after he has fretted.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after 'physicist' stands for 'is'. Anders Angstrom gave his name to a tiny unit of length.
explanation.definitionFit: Anders Jonas Angstrom was a nineteenth-century Swedish scientist of spectroscopy.

clue.text: Formerly about back street

indicators.note: back says the word before it is turned round

parts.note: re means about, as in business letters

explanation.surface: In the old days, around the back alley.
explanation.walkthrough: RE turned back gives ER, then ST.
explanation.definitionFit: Erst is an archaic word for once or previously.

clue.text: Wrinkled prunes dieter initially rejected contemptuously

indicators.note: wrinkled crumples the word, so its letters are rearranged
initially takes just the opening letter

explanation.surface: Someone on a diet turns up their nose at some shrivelled dried fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearrange PRUNES to SPURNE and add D from 'dieter'.
explanation.definitionFit: Spurned means scorned or dismissed with disdain.

clue.text: A part of bible following story -one concerned with money

indicators.note: following puts the earlier pieces after the story

parts.note: an account is a narrative
NT is the New Testament

explanation.surface: A passage from scripture after a tale, from a person handling finances.
explanation.walkthrough: 'following' places the A and the New Testament abbreviation after the story; the dash before 'one' leads to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An accountant keeps and audits financial records.

clue.text: There's a sort of flap, maybe, on the flight

definitions.text: There's a sort of flap, maybe, on the flight

parts.words: There's a sort of flap, maybe, on the flight
parts.note: not a panic during a journey, but a hinged surface on an aircraft wing

explanation.surface: Passengers get into a bit of a panic during the journey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flap' suggests a fuss, but is a wing part.
explanation.definitionFit: This hinged control surface on a plane's wing tilts it to roll in flight.

clue.text: Universal record contributing to part of body in port

indicators.note: the pieces are added into the middle of the other

parts.note: a bone is part of the skeleton
U is the film certificate for universal
a log is a record

explanation.surface: A universal record that helps with a body part found in a harbour.
explanation.walkthrough: U is the British film certificate meaning suitable for all; 'contributing to' signals that pieces go into the body part.
explanation.definitionFit: Boulogne-sur-Mer is a French harbour town on the Channel.

clue.text: A group of stars on about the former capital

indicators.note: about means the first piece goes around the second

parts.note: taken as written
Rio de Janeiro was Brazil's capital before Brasilia

explanation.surface: Astronomers go on about the stars over an old capital city.
explanation.walkthrough: Rio de Janeiro was replaced as Brazil's capital by Brasilia in 1960, hence 'former capital'.
explanation.definitionFit: Orion is a prominent constellation, the hunter.

clue.text: Pound put in to increase rapidly? This could describe the system

indicators.note: put in means one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: prices soar when they rise sharply
L is the abbreviation for the pound, from libra

explanation.surface: A pound invested to grow fast, describing an economic system.
explanation.walkthrough: L goes into SOAR; the definition points to the planets around the sun.
explanation.definitionFit: The sun and its planets are called the solar system.

clue.text: Antibiotics partially applied to the ear

indicators.note: partially says only part of the word is used

explanation.surface: Some antibiotics are given as ear drops.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer lies inside antibiOTICs.
explanation.definitionFit: Otic means relating to the ear, from the Greek for ear.

clue.text: Once current in 22

parts.note: a coin formerly in circulation in a French port, before the euro replaced the franc

explanation.surface: Something that used to flow in a port.
explanation.walkthrough: 'current' suggests electricity or water, but means currency, valid before 2002.
explanation.definitionFit: The centime was a hundredth of a French franc.

clue.text: Rooters excited the bullfighters

indicators.note: excited stirs the letters into another order

explanation.surface: Enthusiastic supporters cheered on the matadors.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearrange ROOTERS, American slang for fans.
explanation.definitionFit: Toreros are the Spanish fighters in the bullring.

clue.text: The outcome including North Carolina's formal declaration

indicators.note: including means one piece is put inside the other

parts.note: the denouement is the final resolution of a plot
NC is the US state abbreviation

explanation.surface: How a story ends, with the state including its official statement.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after North Carolina is a link meaning 'is'; 'The outcome' is the French-derived term for the resolution of a plot.
explanation.definitionFit: A denouncement is a public condemnation or accusation.
